release_blockers.finding: snapshot_path cannot prove absence or snapshot a path on any mount distinct from /. It opens / and immediately requires the root descriptor device and mount ID to equal the target mount. The required /dev/shm tree therefore always raises before traversing into tmpfs.
evidence: storage_contract.py:524-529 opens / then compares that descriptor with expected_device and mount_id.
Both checked-in focused suites error in test_absent_cache_snapshot_is_exact_and_anchored.
Independent read-only probe: / device 64513, /dev/shm device 29, mount ID 35, absent /dev/shm target -> ContractError snapshot root mount/device mismatch.
release_blockers.impact: A later G0 finalizer cannot execute the required exact fresh tmpfs absence/cache path gate. The current package is not a usable fail-closed basis for G0 finalizer preparation.
release_blockers.minimal_repair: Anchor the full lexical chain at / without requiring every pre-mount ancestor to have the target device/mount ID; identify and pin the exact authenticated target mount root, enforce the expected device/mount ID from that boundary downward, revalidate every pre- and post-boundary ancestor, and add passing root-filesystem and /dev/shm cross-mount present/absent tests plus ancestor/bind/symlink/swap attacks.
